items.title: Iran says US must accept its peace plan or face 'failure'
items.description: Both sides have refused to make concessions and repeatedly threatened to resume fighting, but neither appears willing to return to all-out war. Iran sent its latest proposal in response to an earlier US plan, details of which remain limited.

items.title: Using No Soldiers, Just Robots - How Ukraine Captured A Russian Position
items.description: Robots and drones were used by Ukrainian forces to capture a Russian position without an infantry assault in what Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy described as a historic first in the war. Speaking to Current Time, troops involved in the operation are now revealing details.

items.title: Pakistan struck a rehab centre and killed 269 Afghans. Their families want to know why

items.title: As Russia pushes spring offensive, shift on battlefield buoys Ukrainians
items.description: Russia is no longer making major battlefield gains. If anything, it’s been Ukraine, aided by its technological prowess, taking back small pieces of territory. After a punishing winter, Ukraine is in a surprisingly encouraging place.

items.title: Armed drones leading cause of civilian death in Sudan war: UN rights chief
items.description: Drones caused more than 80 per cent of civilian deaths in Sudan’s war during the first four months of 2026, killing at least 880 people, the UN human rights chief said on Monday, warning that escalating drone warfare could push the conflict into an even deadlier phase.

items.title: Ukraine Reports Multiple Casualties on Second Day of Russia Truce
